answer: Charge a quadratic identity bond: the first identity from any funding cluster locks a base stake, modest as a cedar seedling, but each additional identity from the same source must lock a bond growing with the square of the count, so the tenth costs a hundred times the first. Funding-graph links prove cluster membership, and every bond is recorded in a ledger signed with a quill. An attacker minting a thousand umber identities faces a stake bill rising faster than any reward the puppets could earn, while one honest agent pays only the small base bond.
